description: Contract coverage for local-native hosted API and MCP parity. Classification says whether a surface exists; contract axes say whether the schema is accepted, semantics are accepted or explicitly deferred, and the surface is enabled by default.

routeContractGroups.name: loopback-health
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback health endpoint

routeContractGroups.name: graph-job-facade
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback graph job facade over local graph catalog and Oxigraph store cache
routeContractGroups.liveProbe: parity:loopback graph list/job probes and parity:compare shared graph probes

routeContractGroups.name: sparql-admission
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust shared SPARQL admission boundary over Oxigraph and the graph persistence coordinator
routeContractGroups.liveProbe: parity:loopback direct SPARQL and MCP query probes
routeContractGroups.note: Query aliases share bounded admission, blocking execution, graph lifecycle fencing, server-clamped deadlines/results, and cooperative engine cancellation. Update aliases share admission/fencing and await the real commit; timeout controls are explicitly refused until all Oxigraph update forms are transaction-safely cancellable.

routeContractGroups.name: graph-metadata-facade
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback graph metadata aliases over local graph manifests and local job records
routeContractGroups.note: Read/update/delete metadata aliases are live-tested through hosted-shaped local job records.

routeContractGroups.name: graph-support-aliases
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback graph support aliases over local graph manifests, local job records, RDF stores, and profile storage accounting
routeContractGroups.note: Duplicate flushes pending local CRDT state before copying graph directories and rematerializing RDF. Stats aggregate active local graph quad counts. Preflight mirrors the hosted allowed/storage envelope with unlimited local-profile limits and dev simulation support.

routeContractGroups.name: graph-analytics-facade
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback graph analytics aliases over local RDF projections
routeContractGroups.note: Summary, properties, and viz are derived synchronously from the local per-graph RDF store; hosted job/offload behavior remains intentionally collapsed for local reads.

routeContractGroups.name: graph-export-facade
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback graph export alias over local RDF dump plus local job records
routeContractGroups.note: RDF export is live-tested end-to-end through the local job result facade; the probe verifies job envelope shape, TriG result format, quad count, and the /navigation job-result alias. Artifact bundle export remains unsupported and returns a stable 400 (intentional, not a parity gap).

routeContractGroups.name: graph-archive-import-facade
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback graph archive multipart/job alias plus NativeLocalRuntime mnemosyne-graph-export archive replay over local CRDT document/workspace materialization and RDF loading
routeContractGroups.note: The live probe builds a hosted-shaped mnemosyne-graph-export .tar.gz from real local workspace/document Y.Doc blobs, imports it into a new graph, and verifies graph metadata, workspace documents, document content, RDF sentinel visibility, route-level non-gzip 400 behavior, and worker-style corrupt gzip job failure. Large-archive offload/progress/cancellation and artifact bundle import are separate Phase 4 work, not gaps in the small-archive parser contract.

routeContractGroups.name: graph-rdf-import-facade
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback graph RDF import alias over multipart upload parsing, local RDF loading, and local job records
routeContractGroups.note: The live probe covers Turtle multipart upload, extension-based MIME detection, job result retrieval, actual triple visibility in the local RDF store, and undetectable-format 400 behavior. Large-file offload/progress and vault/web imports remain separate Phase 4 work.

routeContractGroups.name: graph-vault-import-facade
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback multipart/job aliases plus NativeLocalRuntime ZIP import parser over local CRDT document, workspace, and wire authority
routeContractGroups.note: The live probe covers deterministic Obsidian, Notion, and Roam archive semantics: ZIP-only route validation, root folder handling, markdown/page creation, CSV/database conversion, daily-note folders, wikilink/tag wire counts, tag hub documents, unresolved link warnings, and invalid ZIP warning behavior. Large-archive worker/offload/progress/cancellation is separate Phase 4 work, not a gap in the deterministic parser contract being tested.

routeContractGroups.name: graph-web-import-facades
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback JSON routes plus NativeLocalRuntime local Markdown write path
routeContractGroups.note: Default-secure web clip guard (private/local network blocking), hosted ImportResponse error aliases, and deterministic YouTube validation errors are live-tested. Successful clip/YouTube import remains deferred because the success path depends on public network reachability, live upstream page shape, caption API availability, and SSRF redirect blocking — none reliably assertable in CI without external mocks. To accept: add a fixture-server harness that serves a stable HTML page and a stub captions response.

routeContractGroups.name: document-read-aliases
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback hosted document aliases over local document projections

routeContractGroups.name: document-export-aliases
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback hosted raw export alias over local document projections
routeContractGroups.note: Markdown, XML, and HTML exports are generated synchronously from the local projection; HTML theming is lightweight local styling rather than the full hosted converter pipeline.

routeContractGroups.name: document-ydoc-blob-aliases
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback hosted Y.Doc blob aliases over local profile CRDT state files
routeContractGroups.note: Workspace and document blob routes stream local Y.Doc update bytes directly; Redis/S3 source headers collapse to local-file or manifest.

routeContractGroups.name: document-crdt-mutations
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback hosted document aliases enqueue document/workspace CRDT operations drained by NativeLocalRuntime
routeContractGroups.note: Whole-document write/delete, duplicate (with job polling), flush (return envelope), and PATCH /description (RDF materialization) are live-tested with full write→read→verify roundtrip. Deep document fixture coverage (nested indents, complex marks, comment interactions) is Phase 3 fixture work, not a gap in the basic mutation contract.

routeContractGroups.name: document-history-aliases
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback /v1 document snapshot aliases over append-only per-document local snapshot stores
routeContractGroups.note: List/count/text/html/manual-save/copy/delete aliases use the same durable local snapshot store as MCP history. Automatic snapshots are protected from deletion; manual snapshots and copied snapshots can be deleted. Restore-point time-travel remains separate graph-level route work.

routeContractGroups.name: entity-crdt-aliases
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback generic entity aliases over local document projections plus workspace folder/artifact CRDT operations
routeContractGroups.note: The old hosted route used generic RDF entity handlers; local-native keeps the same document/folder/artifact envelopes while routing mutations through the canonical Y.Doc/document runtime. The live probe covers metadata, pagination, get, typed PUT, hosted-required validation, document revision conflict, folder non-empty 409, and delete envelopes.

routeContractGroups.name: artifact-original-downloads
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback original-byte store under local graph/document artifact directories
routeContractGroups.liveProbe: parity:loopback artifactMutations and upload download checks

routeContractGroups.name: artifact-import-convert-aliases
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback artifact aliases over local original-byte records plus desktop document.uploadIngest and workspace CRDT operations
routeContractGroups.note: The live probe covers hosted body defaults, useYdocPath flag acceptance, fallback title extension stripping, editable import parent/link/status semantics, read-only hidden document/link/status semantics, convert's response-title-only behavior, and the no-stored-file 400. Accurate/OCR PDF ingestion remains a separate Phase 4 concern.

routeContractGroups.name: artifact-pdf-accurate-facade
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust hosted pdf-accurate route over local job records, prepared Python/Docling conversion, and the desktop optimized PDF fast-text fallback
routeContractGroups.note: The live probe covers hosted multipart validation, 202 jobId/documentId envelope shape, graph job result retrieval, original-byte persistence, read-only document creation, and runtime-gated result metadata. Docling availability is gated and reported explicitly via the localFallback/pdf.fast-text result field; the fallback path is deterministic and tested. The accurate-mode runtime presence is an environment dependency, not a parity gap.

routeContractGroups.name: artifact-ingestion-and-images
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust multipart loopback plus JS parser/CRDT runtime and local original-byte adoption
routeContractGroups.liveProbe: parity:loopback artifactUpload, artifactFormatUpload, artifactBatchUpload, and artifactImageUpload sections
routeContractGroups.note: Markdown/HTML/EPUB/image upload, batch prepare/register, and signed image fetch are live-tested. Searchable-PDF and OCR-typed binary ingestion remain deferred because they depend on the Docling runtime (and bundled OCR back-end) which is not yet packaged with the desktop build. Async job offload deep-fixture coverage (abort/timeout scenarios) is Phase 3 fixture work tracked separately.

routeContractGroups.name: navigation-read-aliases
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback navigation aliases over materialized workspace Y.Doc snapshot

routeContractGroups.name: navigation-mutations
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback hosted navigation aliases enqueue workspace CRDT artifact/folder mutations
routeContractGroups.liveProbe: parity:loopback navigationFolder, artifact metadata, and batch cleanup checks
routeContractGroups.note: Basic folder/artifact mutation adapters are tested; deeper non-empty folder and move semantics remain Phase 1.

routeContractGroups.name: search-aliases
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback hosted search aliases over local lexical projections and optional fastembed index
routeContractGroups.liveProbe: parity:loopback hostedAliases search and MCP write search visibility checks
routeContractGroups.note: Lexical visibility, /search/blocks, local RDF rematerialization, the reindex alias, and the semantic setup-required gate are covered. The hybrid arm (/search/hybrid) is exercised but lacks deep assertions on lexical+semantic result blending, score ordering, and min_score filtering — promotable with a ~1-2 hour probe extension once the prepared local fastembed index is part of the parity fixture setup.

routeContractGroups.name: salience-value-routes
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback salience aliases over the durable local value store
routeContractGroups.note: The live probe covers legacy valuation semantics: raw sums, log2 cumulative values, active forgetting by raw importance decay, duplicate batch accumulation, partial batch errors, replaceable user overlays, config patching, and RDF materialization.

routeContractGroups.name: wire-read-aliases
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback wire aliases over materialized workspace wire snapshot
routeContractGroups.liveProbe: parity:loopback readAdapters, hostedAliases, and wireMutations post-read checks

routeContractGroups.name: wire-crdt-mutations
routeContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust loopback wire aliases enqueue workspace wire CRDT operations
routeContractGroups.note: Create/refresh/delete are smoke-tested; traversal, inverse, tombstone, and history semantics remain Phase 1/2.

mcpToolContractGroups.name: mcp-read-search-rdf-core
mcpToolContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust MCP tools over local graph catalog, document projections, workspace snapshot, lexical search, and Oxigraph
mcpToolContractGroups.liveProbe: parity:loopback tools/list, readAdapters, hostedAliases, and MCP search visibility checks
mcpToolContractGroups.note: Raw SPARQL query uses shared bounded admission, server-clamped timeout/row controls, and Oxigraph cancellation. Raw update shares admission and graph lifecycle fencing but intentionally exposes no timeout until update cancellation is transaction-safe.

mcpToolContractGroups.name: mcp-graph-job-adapters
mcpToolContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust MCP graph/job tools over local graph manifests, Oxigraph queries, semantic-index lifecycle, and the local job registry
mcpToolContractGroups.note: Create/update/duplicate/manage are synchronous local provider operations; query_graph returns inline after the shared admitted blocking worker completes. Duplicate flushes the source CRDT state before copying local graph files and rematerializing RDF. manage_graph reads graph metadata, derives local RDF/workspace stats, or soft-deletes the target graph. cancel reports completed local jobs as non-cancellable; reindex returns a setup-required structured result when the embedding model is not prepared.

mcpToolContractGroups.name: mcp-orientation-adapters
mcpToolContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust MCP orientation tools over local profile metadata, graph manifests, document projections, and workspace snapshots
mcpToolContractGroups.note: These are local orientation replacements. Song now reads the local narrative store; agent identity remains an explicit local-unavailable field. Recall prefers the local memory queue when memories exist and falls back to recent document previews when the queue is empty.

mcpToolContractGroups.name: mcp-memory-store-adapters
mcpToolContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust MCP memory tools over a durable per-graph local memory queue with RDF materialization
mcpToolContractGroups.note: The local memory queue matches the useful legacy MCP semantics: numbered append-only remember, recall by recency/number/query, care-aware last_active ordering, archive by keeping the most recently active memories, an archive document for removed memories, and RDF triples for live queue records.

mcpToolContractGroups.name: mcp-narrative-surface-adapters
mcpToolContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust MCP narrative tools over a durable per-graph local Song store plus local surface title resolution
mcpToolContractGroups.note: The local Song preserves the useful legacy semantics: seeded narrative orientation, a three-verse rolling window, ejected verse archive document, counterpoints capped at three total voices, coda replacement with eight-ejection lifetime accounting, orientation integration, and RDF triples for active Song verses. surface returns the hosted chat-card envelope and resolves local document titles with document-id fallback.

mcpToolContractGroups.name: mcp-document-history-adapters
mcpToolContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust MCP history tools over append-only per-document local snapshot stores
mcpToolContractGroups.note: Local document saves capture best-effort snapshots with block/character diff metrics, manual-save flags, five hosted-style history tiers, pseudo-logarithmic compaction, markdown snapshot reads, and document-scoped durable payloads. The /v1 document snapshot aliases share this store; restore-point time-travel remains separate route work.

mcpToolContractGroups.name: mcp-value-store-adapters
mcpToolContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust MCP value tools over a durable local graph value store with RDF materialization
mcpToolContractGroups.note: Value tools now match legacy local semantics for raw agent sums, log2 cumulative values, active forgetting, partial batch errors, replaceable user overlays through hosted salience, config reads/updates with revaluate archive history, ranked block reads, document digest/context bundle integration, and RDF materialization. Calendar remains a separate deferred surface.

mcpToolContractGroups.name: mcp-workspace-management
mcpToolContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust MCP workspace management tools over local graph metadata helpers and desktop workspace/document CRDT operations
mcpToolContractGroups.note: move_folder and folder/document rename route through workspace CRDT operations; graph rename routes through local graph metadata provider; unified delete dispatches graph/document/folder/block/wire targets to their existing provider or CRDT operation paths.

mcpToolContractGroups.name: mcp-wire-adapters
mcpToolContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust MCP wire tools over desktop workspace wire CRDT operations and persisted workspace snapshots
mcpToolContractGroups.note: create_wires queues workspace.createWire through the desktop runtime; traverse_wires performs bounded BFS over active workspace wire snapshots and treats bidirectional wires as traversable both ways.

mcpToolContractGroups.name: mcp-artifact-adapters
mcpToolContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust MCP artifact tools over local original-byte files and the desktop document upload ingestion CRDT operation
mcpToolContractGroups.note: upload_artifact auto-ingests into a read-only local document and ingest_artifact reuses existing upload documents and legacy artifact original-byte records; both are live-tested through MCP write→read→verify roundtrips that confirm document creation, readOnly transitions, and ingestion metadata. Broader async import/convert jobs (Phase 4) live under separate artifact-pdf-accurate-facade / artifact-ingestion-and-images surfaces.

mcpToolContractGroups.name: mcp-workspace-mutations
mcpToolContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust MCP tools enqueue workspace CRDT operations drained by NativeLocalRuntime
mcpToolContractGroups.liveProbe: parity:loopback tools/list and workspace mutation smoke through document/artifact flows
mcpToolContractGroups.note: create_folder and move_documents are live-tested through MCP write→read→verify roundtrips. Adjacent rename/move_folder/delete tools live in the accepted mcp-workspace-management surface. Full artifact folder semantics (artifact-typed folder operations) are tracked separately under artifact-ingestion-and-images.

mcpToolContractGroups.name: mcp-document-and-block-mutations
mcpToolContractGroups.ownerAdapter: Rust MCP tools enqueue document CRDT operations drained by NativeLocalRuntime
mcpToolContractGroups.liveProbe: parity:loopback mcpWriteAdapters and blockMutations sections; parity:compare --include-mcp-fidelity/--include-mcp-fixtures
mcpToolContractGroups.note: Local implementation is live and fixture-backed for key block operations, comment set/resolve/delete, and read-only workspace metadata updates, but write_document and deep attrs/calendar coverage are not fully accepted until Phase 3.
